stem.text: Cholesterol is an integral component of the cell surface membrane.
Which statement about cholesterol is correct?

A.text: It allows ions to pass freely through the cell surface membrane.

B.text: It has a hydrophobic head and a hydrophilic tail.

C.text: It helps to regulate the fluidity of the cell surface membrane.

D.text: It reduces the mechanical stability of the phospholipid bilayer.
